simple.meaning: שָׂכִיר (sâkîyr) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a man at wages by the day or year.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 12:45. The surrounding context includes priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂכִיר (H7916) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: a man at wages by the day or year
definitions.full: H7916. sakir שָׂכִיר adjective hired ; — absolute ׳שׂ Exodus 14:45 +, feminine שְׂכִירָה Isa 7:20 ; construct שְׂכֹיר Lev 25:53 ; suffix שְׂכִירְךָ 25:6 ; plural suffix שְׂכִרֶיהָ Jer 46:21 ; — 1 hired , of beast Exod 22:14 (E), razor Isa 7:20 (figurative). 2 usually as substantive hireling, hired labourer Deut 15:18 ; 24:14 ; Lev 19:13 ; 22:10 ; 25:6 , 40 , 53 (all H), Exod 12:45 ; Lev 25:50 (both P), Mal 3:5 ; Job 7:1-2 , 14:6 ; שׂ ׳כִּשְׁנֵי Isa 16:14 years like a hireling's years (reckoned strictly), so 21:16 ; mercenaries Jer 46:21 . יִשָּׂשׂכָר see above

occurrences.englishText: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.
“If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
“ ‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him.
“ ‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.
As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.
It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you; for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God will bless you in all that you do.
You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.
“Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth?
As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow,
Look away from him, that he may rest,

But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall;

I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.
